comments.body:
## Experiment result: search-frontier exclusion-list resumption — VERDICT: NO-GO

PoC per insecure-resistant-shibainu (0b55-8202). Harness: throwaway, in-worktree monkeypatch harness (no src/rebar changes, nothing pushed). Forced exhaustion via flat verify_step_floor=16 at both bindings (rebar.llm.completion + rebar.llm.workflow.completion_banking); per-(ticket,arm) isolated verdict-cache namespaces (completion_verdict_cache.cache_dir patched); attempt-0 cache copied once per arm; transcripts captured by wrapping pai_tools.filesystem_tools/grounding_tools/rebar_tools (allow_comment forced False) + completion_recovery.make_completion_record_tool; treatment frontier block (<=1500 chars, data-shaped, zero imperative sentences) spliced by wrapping STEP_REGISTRY['completion_precheck'] inside the <untrusted_ticket_context> fence. All runs verify_completion(source='local', fetch=False) — read-only, never signs. Model: bedrock sonnet (standard class). No environmental errors; every run completed.

### Metrics table (per ticket, per attempt)
Overlap = evidence tool calls (read_file/list_directory/search_files/resolve_symbol/show_ticket) whose exact arguments repeat any earlier attempt of the same arm (attempt 0 counts as shared history).

| ticket | attempt | arm | verdict | overlap repeats/calls (rate) | newly-cached PASS | new-PASS/request | requests | in tok | out tok | wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 45c1 (bettong, 6 AC) | 0 exhaust | shared | FAIL | — | 3 | 0.33 | 9 | 669,428 | 2,594 | 62s |
| 45c1 | 1 | A ctl | PASS | 2/8 (25.0%) | 3 | 0.33 | 9 | 625,342 | 2,550 | 62s |
| 45c1 | 1 | B trt | PASS | 4/9 (44.4%) | 3 | 0.25 | 12 | 644,424 | 3,425 | 83s |
| 8d74 (ostrich, 4 AC) | 0 exhaust | shared | FAIL | — | 1 | 0.08 | 13 | 530,182 | 3,201 | 67s |
| 8d74 | 1 | A ctl | FAIL | 3/10 (30.0%) | 1 | 0.08 | 13 | 214,762 | 2,807 | 58s |
| 8d74 | 2 | A ctl | PASS | 6/8 (75.0%) | 2 | 0.22 | 9 | 146,335 | 2,674 | 55s |
| 8d74 | 1 | B trt | FAIL | 6/8 (75.0%) | 2 | 0.15 | 13 | 264,243 | 3,351 | 71s |
| 8d74 | 2 | B trt | PASS | 2/2 (100%) | 0* | 0 | 8 | 176,145 | 2,144 | 52s |

*B2 PASSed as a within-budget primary; on primary success the bank is discarded unread, so nothing new persists to the cache (mechanism, not a defect).

### Predeclared decision rule, applied verbatim
GO required, on EVERY ticket: (i) >=30% relative reduction in re-search overlap for B vs A AND (ii) attempts-to-clean <= A.
- 45c1: arm overlap A 25.0% vs B 44.4% — a +78% relative INCREASE (fails i). Attempts-to-clean A=1, B=1 (ii ok).
- 8d74: cumulative overlap A 9/18 (50.0%) vs B 8/10 (80.0%) — a +60% relative INCREASE (fails i). Attempts A=2, B=2 (ii ok).
(i) fails on BOTH tickets → **NO-GO**. No arm errored environmentally, so not INDETERMINATE.

Token cost delta (resume attempts only, attempt-0 shared): 45c1 B +3.1% input / +34% output / +3 requests vs A; 8d74 B +21.9% input / +0.3% output / -1 request vs A. The frontier block bought no cost reduction either.

### Why it lost (mechanism, from the transcripts)
1. The fence renders the block inert BY DESIGN — and it did. In 45c1 B1 the model's first two calls exactly repeated searches listed under "searched-and-empty" in the frontier block it had just been handed.
2. Worse, the frontier can act as a signpost: in 8d74 B1 the model immediately re-read, in order, the five files listed under "files-already-read" — the block names where the evidence lives, so a resumption goes straight back there, RAISING measured overlap. (That re-reading is partly rational: a verifier must re-ground evidence it re-asserts; those reads are not pure waste.)
3. The overlap-rate denominator punishes efficient runs: 8d74 B2 made only 2 evidence calls (vs A2's 8) — the most focused run in the corpus — but both repeated prior arguments, scoring 100%. By absolute repeat COUNT 8d74 B (8) edged A (9), but 45c1 B (4) still doubled A (2); no reading reaches the 30% reduction bar on every ticket.
4. The cache-seeding "already credited — do not re-verify" manifest (the locust behavior) already removes the dominant redundancy — re-proving credited criteria. What remains is re-grounding of still-unproven criteria, which a data-shaped exclusion list inside an untrusted fence cannot and should not suppress.

### Caveats
N=2 tickets, 1 replicate per (ticket,arm) — this is a PoC screen for whether a real investment is warranted, NOT a significance claim. Single model class, single reduced budget (16 steps), greedy decoding; sampling variance across arms is uncontrolled at N=1 per cell.

### What telemetry production would need (if ever revisited)
Argument-level tool-call transcripts per verifier run: tool name + full arguments (paths, line windows, search patterns) + an empty/non-empty result classification + criterion-boundary markers (record_criterion_verdict sequence positions), persisted per (ticket, run) alongside the verdict cache. Today usage_log carries only aggregate requests/tool_calls/shape fields, and the bank deliberately stores no tool arguments — the PoC had to capture all of this harness-side.

## Why
Operator direction (2026-08-15): approach chauvinist-subsolar-arctichare (19ea-29af-ebb3-410b) as an EXPERIMENT. The auto-resume design (adolescent-evilminded-locust) re-runs the whole verifier and relies on the verdict cache to skip credited criteria; it passes NO information about WHERE the failed attempt already searched. Question to answer empirically: does handing a resumption the prior attempt's search frontier as an EXCLUSION list ("already searched, found nothing: ...") measurably reduce re-search overlap and steps-to-verdict? Blocker noted at design time: verifier telemetry does not carry argument-level tool-call transcripts — the PoC must capture them harness-side.

## Protocol (rapid PoC — throwaway harness, no production code)
1. Corpus: >=2 real CLOSED tickets with large surfaces (description near the 8000-char cap, many prose ACs/comments). Run read-only (--source local, never signs). Cache lifecycle (one policy, all steps): each (ticket, arm) pair gets an ISOLATED cache namespace — the harness monkeypatches `cache_dir` (src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_verdict_cache.py:59, the single derivation of `.rebar/cache/completion_verdicts/...` from `_resolve_root`) to return a per-arm temp dir, the standard unit-suite technique; nothing under the real store is touched. Attempt 1 (forced exhaustion) runs with cache ACTIVE but EMPTY — banking must fill it, and prior real-store verdicts cannot leak in. Its populated cache is then COPIED once and each resume arm reads its own identical copy.
2. Transcript capture: wrap the verifier's tool executor in-harness (monkeypatch at the workflow seam) to log every tool call with full arguments (file paths read, grep patterns, dirs listed) per criterion.
3. Force exhaustion: a config-level budget cannot go low — the computed floor is AUTHORITATIVE over smaller configured values (src/rebar/llm/completion.py:237 raises max_iterations up to verify_step_floor). The harness therefore monkeypatches `verify_step_floor` to return the reduced budget (e.g. 12-20 steps) for every arm and attempt uniformly — patched at BOTH bindings, since completion_banking.py:38 binds the name at import time: `rebar.llm.completion.verify_step_floor` AND `rebar.llm.workflow.completion_banking.verify_step_floor` (patch-where-used); attempt 1 then FAILs insufficiency-only with a partial bank; keep the transcript.
4. Extract frontier: from the transcript, derive per-criterion searched-set (paths read, patterns tried) and a compact data-shaped frontier block (<=1500 chars, list form, zero imperative sentences).
5. Resume LOOP per arm, same reduced budget every attempt, each arm on its own copy of the attempt-1 cache (per the step-1 policy): repeat the re-run until overall PASS or 3 resume attempts, whichever first; the cache accrues within the arm across attempts (that accrual IS the resume mechanism). (A) CONTROL — plain re-runs, cache-seeded only (locust behavior). (B) TREATMENT — identical, plus a frontier EVIDENCE block spliced into the fenced ticket context, regenerated after each attempt from that arm's cumulative transcript. Seam (mirrors the framework's own evidence precedent): the harness wraps the registered `completion_precheck` step (src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py:48) and inserts the block into its returned `context` inside the `<untrusted_ticket_context>` fence (:229) — exactly how framework-computed child-closure proof (gate_ops.py:226-228 via build_child_closure_evidence) and the epic bug screen land today. The block is DATA-shaped, never directive ("frontier: searched-and-empty: <path/pattern list>" — no instructions), because the fence renders directive text inert by design; the packaged reviewer prompt is NOT edited. This also makes the treatment production-faithful: if it wins, the productized form IS a framework-attached evidence block at this seam.
6. Metrics table (the deliverable): re-search overlap rate per attempt (tool calls repeating any earlier attempt's arguments, same arm) A vs B, newly-banked PASSes per step A vs B, attempts-to-clean-close (or 'not clean in 3') A vs B, token cost delta.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Harness exists in the experiment worktree (throwaway; NOT pushed to Gerrit; no src/rebar changes).
- [x] Argument-level transcripts captured for >=2 large tickets across forced-exhaustion + both resume arms.
- [x] Metrics table posted as a comment on THIS ticket and on chauvinist-subsolar-arctichare: overlap rate, PASS-per-step, attempts, cost.
- [x] Verdict comment applies the PREDECLARED decision rule: GO if, on EVERY corpus ticket, the treatment arm (B) shows (i) re-search overlap rate reduced by >=30% relative to control AND (ii) attempts-to-clean-close <= control; NO-GO if either fails on any ticket; INDETERMINATE if any arm errors environmentally (report raw numbers regardless). Include what telemetry production would need to carry. N is small (2+ tickets) — the rule is a PoC screen for whether a real investment is warranted, not a significance claim, and the comment must say so.
- [x] No store writes beyond ticket comments; no signatures minted (--source local only).
